# Bid the stops, the shaft, and the extras.

> Price a residential home elevator from stops, travel, pneumatic versus hydraulic versus traction MRL, through-floor versus a new shaft, acrylic versus glass cab, and extras — plus the walk-away price an $18,995 pneumatic special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
